name: whoami-all
title: CLI Accounts
description: See which account every CLI on your Mac is logged in as (GitHub, Cloudflare, AWS, Tailscale, Claude Code, ...) and switch with one keystroke. Never touches tokens.
author: warapolj

commands.name: who-am-i
commands.title: Who Am I
commands.subtitle: CLI Accounts
commands.description: List the account every CLI is logged in as, with actions to switch or log in.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: CLI Accounts in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: CLI Accounts
commands.description: Show your current account for one CLI in the menu bar, with every other login one click away.

preferences.name: menuBarTool
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.description: Which CLI's account to show in the menu bar.

preferences.name: scriptPath
preferences.title: whoami-all Script
preferences.description: Path to your own whoami-all script. Leave empty to use the copy bundled with the extension.

preferences.name: terminal
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Where login commands run (they usually open a browser).

preferences.name: showMissing
preferences.title: Not Installed
preferences.label: Show tools that aren't installed
preferences.description: List CLIs that aren't installed on this Mac in their own section.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
